objective: Establish Treasurer as the first-class economic control-plane seam while preserving Overseer supremacy, Guardian capability authority, ComputeRouter physical placement, worker execution boundaries, Slayer enforcement, Healer recovery, and F07 verification.

rulesConsidered: One sovereign command authority: Overseer beneath Human Authority.
Control plane is decoupled from production execution.
F07/Auditor remains the independent evidence boundary.
Economic reservation must occur before discretionary resource consumption.
Released reservations are not settled spend.

notes: Mongo production persistence is fail-closed without a transaction-capable Mongo client.
Treasurer cannot mint capabilities, select physical workers, or certify verification.

conflicts.originalConflict: Introducing a named Treasurer could accidentally create a second sovereign command authority or a second physical scheduler.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Define Treasurer as a cross-cutting economic authority subordinate to Overseer; permit-only resource control; Guardian remains capability authority; ComputeRouter remains physical placement authority.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Treasurer receives discretionary economic commands only from Overseer and may autonomously execute only deterministic constitutional safety actions.

conflicts.originalConflict: Existing quota, mission-budget, CostGovernor and AgentEconomics mechanisms could be duplicated rather than unified.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Keep existing mechanisms as compatibility paths during staged migration; make Treasury the economic admission seam before declaring those mechanisms non-authoritative.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Wave 1 introduces the canonical Treasury kernel and persistence without a risky all-at-once runtime rewrite.

changes: Added Treasury contracts for commands, quotes, reservations, consumption, permits, accounts, policies and immutable ledger events.
Added deterministic Treasury Constitutional Kernel with fail-closed admission and settlement semantics.
Added MongoDB transactional ledger and in-memory test ledger.
Added TreasuryService and Mongo-backed service factory.
Added unit tests for authority, idempotency, verification, release, overrun freeze, paid-route policy, defensive mode, expiry and concurrency.
Updated .okf hierarchy, terminology, index, compute policy and current-state audit.
Aligned the existing ComfyUI MCP architecture document with its pre-existing CI contract by naming the TRANSFORM_VISUAL_ASSET semantic action.
